Synthesis warnings that matter

You will learn

How to read a yosys log, and the warnings that become bugs on silicon.

yosys tells you a lot, and most of it is fine. A few lines are not: a latch you did not mean, a wire nothing drives, two drivers on one net, a memory that became flip-flops. Each of those works in simulation and fails on the chip. Open one of the real logs from t27 specs, then paste a log of your own.

Try it

Open each real log and find the one that yosys refused, and why.

Open the interactive lesson →

Paste or drop a yosys synth_xilinx log: latches, undriven wires, driver conflicts, memories turned into flip-flops, warnings and final cell counts, read in your browser.
